name: Soul's Color
source:
The god of time has failed you and now as a reward you have been reincarnated in a land full of beastmen. Forge your destiny!

[From [url=https://project-souls.itch.io/soulscolor]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
时间之神让你失望了，现在作为奖励，你已经转世到了一片充满兽人的土地上。铸就你的命运！

[来自[url=https://project-souls.itch.io/soulscolor]Itch.io[/url]]
